Name: Legalized
Author: coolsp0t
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/24398/24398-1716503145-521126382.png[/img]
[b][size=4]A Cannabis Crop Extension Modification[/size][/b]

[b]A small Modification aimed to be vanilla friendly & tries to fit as well as possible between mid and late game.[/b]

Harvest & fabricate cannabis sativa, indica and hybrid to oil or jive's. A few villagers in stardew valley likes to use cannabis.
Vanilla friendly sell prices. Full german translation included. 25 new cannabis themed items.[/center]

[b][u]How to install:[/u][/b]
- install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
- install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download Legalized & unzip the content of the 7Zip file into your stardew valley game folder -> mods
[b]Example:[/b] c:\steam\steamapps\common\stardew valley\mods


[b]- Gameplay -[/b]
[spoiler]- Sandy sells all kind of cannabis seeds for 100 each.
- Fresh Cannabis needs to be dried in the Dehydrator.
- Oil Maker can make Oil from dry Cannabis.
- Roll-It-Up Device added to produce Jive's from dry Cannabis.
[/spoiler]
[b]- Gifts -[/b]
[spoiler]- When 3 hearts friended with Sandy will she gifts you the cooking recipe for "Indica Cake".
- When 5 hearts friended with Sandy will she gifts you the cooking recipe for "Sativa Cake".
- When 5 hearts friended with Evelyn will she gifts you the cooking recipe for "Hybrid Cake".
- When 5 hearts friended with Shane will he gifts you the cooking recipe for "Indica Brownie".
- When 5 hearts friended with Clint will he gifts you the cooking recipe for "Sativa Lollipop".
[/spoiler]
